text:
tess: Noticing a small surge in cross-tenant tail latency in apac-south this morning. Correlates with two hosts in rack-3 showing NIC RX drops + cloud-provider fabric reroute. Some shared slices spilled; one dedicated slice experienced a 4x token-cost bump due to kv-cache regen.

omar: Can you paste the quick allocator excerpt?

tess: Sure: `allocator WARN mark_unhealthy host=node-3-21 reason=nic_rx_errors count=1` then `allocator INFO spill tenant=shared-batch -> fallback-route=preemptible` within 30s.

lee: Sounds like allocator acted on single RX_err which is noisy. Suggest we add a routing constraint: prefer spill to preemptible pool unless dedicated_pools_at_risk=true. We already have soft routing but the threshold is too low.

tess: Agreed. Immediate mitigation: temporarily raise the spill-to-preemptible threshold and whitelist high-SLA dedicated pools for 45m. I'll apply.

omar: Also adding that we should surface a "spill-cost" metric per tenant so SRE/CS can see regen billing. Right now it's buried.

infra-bot: policy-change applied id=pcie-avoid-1781239876; change=whitelist dedicated-apac-south for 2700s by tess.

oncall: HW team asked for NIC logs; will validate cable and switch ASIC errors. If hardware clean, we need to debounce NIC error -> unhealthy path in allocator.

lee: Long-term proposal: change allocator health policy to require two independent signals before preemptive drain: (1) heartbeat_miss >=2 OR (2) NIC_err_count >=2 within 60s OR (3) control-plane leader-loss. Also add placement rule that avoids colocating heavy-batch and low-latency slices on same host by default.

tess: Filing follow-up ticket with timeline and action items. For now: 1) whitelist dedicated pools (done) 2) raise spill-to-preemptible threshold (in progress) 3) HW check (oncall) 4) metric tile for spill-cost (omar).

lee: I'll draft the PR for allocator debounce tonight. Keep thread open 12h for recurrence notes.
